final_claim: For two scalar unequal-curvature strongly convex components with opposing linear offsets and symmetric two-state Markov sampling, within individual contraction h<2/(1+t), the exact stationary mean-square iterate is optimized only by p=0 alternation if h(1−t²)<1, only p=1 persistence if >1; endpoints tie at equality t>0; all p tie at h=1,t=0. Persistence regime exists iff t<1/2.
